provenance.method: Boosted regression trees on log(fresh yield per m2). Light enters as daily light integral; per-plant mass is served as per-area yield divided by the plant density the caller states.

development.note: Reported for transparency and for comparison with v2 on the same six observations. Not evidence of independent accuracy.

refused.why: The per-area identity assumes per-area yield does not depend on density. At 1000 plants/m2 Touliatos report 95 kg/m2 per occupied floor area, which includes stacking across layers, so the identity is known to break here. Refused rather than scored.

independent.study: Touliatos D, Dodd IC, McAinsh M (2016) Vertical farming increases lettuce yield per unit area compared to conventional horizontal hydroponics. Food and Energy Security 5(3):184-191, doi:10.1002/fes3.83
independent.verdict: Fails the 30% criterion; the improvement over v2 is real but the model is not validated for harvest forecasting.
